description:
-Spacious 2 Bedroom Third Floor Apartment With West Facing Balcony

-'B' Rated BER

-Just Steps from The LUAS

-Under Building Private & Secure Parking

-Excellent Storage Both Inside & Out

-Excellent Location Close To All Amenities

Premium Collection is delighted to present this highly desirable 2 bedroom apartment in the heart of the very popular Tullyvale development in Cherrywood. Offering a BER rating of 'B' and only steps from the LUAS, this third floor residence is light and bright with a west facing aspect providing good views from a spacious balcony with additional storage.

Benefiting from the excellent amenities that Tullyvale has to offer, this apartment also includes private and secure parking under the building with direct elevator access together with intercom front door security.

Accessed from a central entrance hallway the spacious main livingroom includes floor to ceiling glass leading out to a good sized outdoor terrace ensuring that lots of natural light fills the whole living space. Including a feature fireplace, the livingroom is open to a well equipped kitchen with shaker style cabinetry and a good selection of stainless steel appliances.

There are fitted wardrobes in both bedrooms and each are light and bright, benefiting from  large west-facing windows. The spacious bathroom comprises a bath shower combination with wall tile to the ceiling and a contemporary tiled floor. 

Outside,one can enjoy the eveing sunshine from the good sized west facing deck which also offers nice views to the north west. There is also a good sized storage unit on this deck and this, along with the separate spacious storage room inside the residence, is always a nice feature to have with apartment living.

Located between the foothills of the Dublin Mountains and the coast, The Oval at Tully Vale is perfectly situated close to both the M50 and N11 with the DART not too far away at Killiney and the LUAS being only steps away. There is a wide selection of schools and colleges nearby and when it come to shops, cafes and restaurants, one is spoiled for choice. In fact, there is hardly any amenity that not convenient to this address and being in move in condition, viewing is highly recommended.
